name: First payment applies the plan waiting period
covers: monthly seven day initial waiting period
quarterly 48 hour initial waiting period
annual 48 hour initial waiting period
payment confirmation starts waiting period
description: Checks that confirmed first payments calculate the correct plan based waiting period and coverage start date.
steps: Sign in as Super Admin and open a pending member payment
Mark a monthly payment as Paid and inspect the member access dates
Repeat with quarterly and annual member payments
expected: Monthly membership starts access seven days after confirmed payment. Quarterly and annual memberships start access 48 hours after confirmed payment.

name: Renewal timing controls continuity or a new waiting period
covers: renewal within 72 hour grace period
late renewal after 72 hours
six day late renewal waiting period
coverage expiry recalculation
description: Checks that on time renewals preserve continuous cover while late renewals trigger the six day waiting period.
steps: Open a member whose coverage expires in the future and mark the renewal Paid
Confirm the next coverage period begins at the previous expiry date
Open a member whose coverage expired more than 72 hours ago and mark the renewal Paid
Review the new waiting period and coverage dates
expected: Renewal within 72 hours after expiry does not add a new wait. Renewal after 72 hours starts a six day wait from payment confirmation, then the new coverage period begins.

name: Member access is blocked until the calculated start date
covers: server side waiting period access gate
member dashboard waiting status
care request blocked during waiting period
description: Checks that a member cannot use care access during a waiting period even when payment is confirmed.
steps: Sign in as a member with a confirmed payment but a future coverage start date
Review the digital access card and membership status
Try to request a benefit eligibility check
expected: The member sees that the waiting period is still active and the server blocks eligibility access until the coverage start date.

name: Existing approvals remain subject to renewal and access controls
covers: human approval requirement
existing access approval retained
expired membership access restriction
description: Checks that waiting period rules do not automatically approve care or bypass expired membership restrictions.
steps: Open a member with approved provider assignment and expired coverage
Attempt an eligibility check before a qualifying renewal payment
Review the result and member access status
expected: The member cannot access care based only on historical approval. Payment and calculated coverage dates are checked, and human approval remains required.

name: Referral rewards, wallet points and member dashboard persist
covers: unique referral code per member
2.5 percent referral commission on confirmed payments
1 percent wallet funding points
one point converts to one naira
wallet funding awaits payment confirmation
member dashboard and wallet reload after sign out and sign in
member wallet privacy boundary
description: Checks that a member can share a unique code, receive confirmed rewards, convert points and see the same saved account after signing in again.
steps: Sign in as Member A and copy the personal referral code
Register Member B using Member A's code and confirm Member B receives a different code
Record a confirmed payment for Member B and check Member A's wallet receives 2.5 percent
Request wallet funding for Member A, confirm it as Super Admin, and check 1 percent is added as points
Convert points and verify one point becomes one naira in wallet balance
Sign out and sign in again as Member A
expected: Each member has a unique referral code. Confirmed referred payments credit 2.5 percent to the referrer. Confirmed wallet funding adds 1 percent as points. Points convert at 1 point to ₦1. The member returns to the same personal dashboard, referral code, wallet balance, points and transaction history.

name: Team roles enforce dashboard and customer data permissions
covers: Super Admin can add admin staff and customer service roles
role specific dashboard navigation
all team roles can register customers
non Super Admin cannot read NIN or date of birth
only Super Admin can delete customers or change sensitive details
description: Checks that team roles receive only their permitted workspace and customer data actions.
steps: Sign in as Super Admin and add one Administrator, one Staff member and one Customer Service user
Sign in as each team role and confirm the dashboard sections match its permissions
Register a customer as each role
Attempt to change a customer's email, phone, NIN and date of birth as a non Super Admin
Attempt to delete a customer as a non Super Admin
expected: Each role sees its assigned dashboard and can register customers. Non Super Admin roles cannot view NIN or date of birth, change sensitive customer information or delete customer records.

name: Emergency guidance and health chat protect users and support clinic search
covers: public emergency guidance for members and nonmembers
red flag symptom escalation without plan purchase delay
conversational Nigerian English health information
nonmember plan purchase link
member location based nearby clinic search
no invented in network clinic or guaranteed coverage claims
description: Checks that the public health assistant gives safe emergency guidance, supports a natural health conversation and directs users to appropriate plan or location resources.
steps: Open the public TrustlineCover landing page and find Emergency Speak to a Doctor
Ask about a severe symptom such as chest pain and review the emergency guidance
Confirm the emergency guidance does not require plan purchase before seeking treatment
Use the assistant as a visitor without an active plan and review the plan link
Select active plan, enter a neighbourhood and review the nearby clinic search link
expected: Potential emergencies are directed to urgent care without delay or a purchase condition. Nonmembers can view plans. Users reporting an active plan can search nearby clinics by location, while the app does not claim a search result is in network or guaranteed to be covered.

name: Members request contact changes for Super Admin approval
covers: member email and phone are not directly editable
member submits email or phone change request
Super Admin approves or rejects contact change
member retains access using original sign in identity after contact email update
description: Verifies that members submit contact changes for review and only the Super Admin can approve them.
steps: Sign in as a member and open the account details section
Submit a request to change the registered phone number or email address
Sign in as Super Admin and review the pending request
Approve the request and return to the member dashboard
expected: The member cannot directly change registered contact details. The request is recorded for Super Admin review, and approved contact details update while the member's original sign in identity remains usable.

name: Email centre permissions and subscription renewal notices
covers: Super Admin only SMTP settings in Website settings
SMTP credentials encrypted and never returned to the frontend
Admin and Staff can send member emails
Customer Service cannot send member emails
email history records SMTP accepted and failed messages
reminder queue created from subscription coverage expiry dates
existing member dates backfilled in bounded batches
duplicate reminder events prevented
description: Verifies SMTP settings access, team email sending and scheduled renewal messages.
steps: Sign in as Super Admin and open Website settings
Save SMTP host, port, username, password and sender details
Send a test email and confirm the password is not displayed
Sign in as Admin and Staff and send an email to selected members
Confirm Customer Service cannot access the Email Centre
Review the email history for SMTP accepted and failed messages
Confirm paid subscription expiry dates create reminders for 7 days, 3 days, 1 day and expiry day
expected: Only Super Admin can configure SMTP. Admin and Staff can send separate emails to selected members. SMTP credentials are encrypted and never returned to the browser. Existing subscriptions are backfilled and paid subscriptions create deduplicated reminder records for 7 days, 3 days, 1 day and expiry day. The daily schedule runs at 8am Nigeria time.
